# Component API

Look up props, events, slots, public types, part selectors, and keyboard behavior by component. Usage guidance and runnable examples stay on each component page.

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Accordion](/api/components/accordion) | Organize related content into independently expandable sections. |
| [Alert Dialog](/api/components/alert-dialog) | Interrupt a destructive action with an explicit confirmation decision. |
| [Calendar](/api/components/calendar) | Navigate a date grid, skip unavailable days, and select a civil date. |
| [Carousel](/api/components/carousel) | Move through a bounded or wrapping sequence of slides with direct controls. |
| [Cascade List](/api/components/cascade-list) | Display hierarchy levels side by side and select a leaf directly. |
| [Cascade Select](/api/components/cascade-select) | Choose a leaf value by moving through progressive hierarchy columns. |
| [Color Picker](/api/components/color-picker) | Edit an exact color through native, text, channel, and spatial controls. |
| [Checkbox](/api/components/checkbox) | Toggle one optional value or represent a partially selected parent. |
| [Checkbox Group](/api/components/checkbox-group) | Select any combination of independent options in one labeled group. |
| [Combobox](/api/components/combobox) | Filter a collection with text, move through matches, and accept one result. |
| [Date Field](/api/components/date-field) | Edit and validate a timezone-free calendar date as structured text. |
| [Date Range Field](/api/components/date-range-field) | Edit two date endpoints while preserving incomplete and invalid drafts. |
| [Date Time Field](/api/components/date-time-field) | Edit a civil date and wall-clock time without timezone conversion. |
| [Date Time Picker](/api/components/date-time-picker) | Choose a local date and time with coordinated field and calendar controls. |
| [Date Time Range Picker](/api/components/date-time-range-picker) | Choose start and end dates with independent wall-clock times. |
| [Date Picker](/api/components/date-picker) | Choose one available date from week, month, or year views. |
| [Date Range Picker](/api/components/date-range-picker) | Choose an inclusive date interval across calendar pages. |
| [Range Calendar](/api/components/range-calendar) | Choose an inclusive date range directly in an always-visible calendar grid. |
| [Month Picker](/api/components/month-picker) | Choose one calendar month from a focused year grid. |
| [Month Range Picker](/api/components/month-range-picker) | Choose an inclusive span of calendar months from one year grid. |
| [Year Picker](/api/components/year-picker) | Choose one year from a compact paged year grid. |
| [Year Range Picker](/api/components/year-range-picker) | Choose an inclusive span of years from a paged year grid. |
| [Dialog](/api/components/dialog) | Open focused content above the page with modal or non-modal behavior. |
| [Drawer](/api/components/drawer) | Reveal focused content from any viewport edge and dismiss it with a directional swipe. |
| [Disclosure](/api/components/disclosure) | Reveal optional content from a single persistent trigger. |
| [Editable](/api/components/editable) | Switch inline content between preview and validated editing states. |
| [Feed](/api/components/feed) | Present live product activity while loading older or newer events without losing reading position. |
| [Grid](/api/components/grid) | Move through two-dimensional cells, select values, and enter edit mode. |
| [Listbox](/api/components/listbox) | Move through a visible option list and select one or several values. |
| [Menu](/api/components/menu) | Navigate hierarchical commands, open submenus, and invoke an action. |
| [Menu Button](/api/components/menu-button) | Open a command menu from one trigger and restore focus on dismissal. |
| [Menubar](/api/components/menubar) | Move across top-level menus before navigating each command hierarchy. |
| [Meter](/api/components/meter) | Show an exact bounded measurement and classify it against quality thresholds. |
| [Meter Group](/api/components/meter-group) | Partition one exact shared capacity into ordered named measurements. |
| [Progress](/api/components/progress) | Show exact task completion or an explicitly indeterminate operation. |
| [Navigation Menu](/api/components/navigation-menu) | Combine native links and expandable navigation panels in one bar. |
| [Multi Thumb Slider](/api/components/multi-thumb-slider) | Adjust several ordered values on one shared numeric track. |
| [Number Field](/api/components/number-field) | Preserve exact decimal input while validating or evaluating text drafts. |
| [Pagination](/api/components/pagination) | Project a large result set into direct pages and boundary controls. |
| [Popover](/api/components/popover) | Attach interactive supporting content to a trigger without blocking the page. |
| [Pin Input](/api/components/pin-input) | Enter a short code across coordinated single-character fields. |
| [Quantity Field](/api/components/quantity-field) | Edit an exact physical quantity and convert compatible display units. |
| [Radio Group](/api/components/radio-group) | Choose exactly one option while moving through a labeled set. |
| [Rating](/api/components/rating) | Choose, change, or clear one score on an ordered rating scale. |
| [Select](/api/components/select) | Choose one value from a trigger-controlled popup list. |
| [Slider](/api/components/slider) | Adjust one quantized numeric value with pointer or keyboard input. |
| [Spin Button](/api/components/spin-button) | Edit a numeric draft directly or change it with increment controls. |
| [Stepper](/api/components/stepper) | Guide a user through ordered tasks with progress and eligibility rules. |
| [Switch](/api/components/switch) | Toggle one persistent setting with an immediate state change. |
| [Tabs](/api/components/tabs) | Switch between peer panels while coordinating focus and activation. |
| [Tags Input](/api/components/tags-input) | Create, navigate, and remove free-form tokens from one text field. |
| [Text](/api/components/text) | Edit Unicode text while preserving selection and IME composition. |
| [Time Field](/api/components/time-field) | Edit and validate a timezone-free wall-clock time. |
| [Time Range Field](/api/components/time-range-field) | Edit start and end times while enforcing interval and order rules. |
| [Timer](/api/components/timer) | Measure elapsed or remaining time with start, pause, and reset actions. |
| [Toast](/api/components/toast) | Queue concise feedback and announce it without interrupting the current task. |
| [Toggle Button](/api/components/toggle-button) | Keep one action pressed until the same action is invoked again. |
| [Toggle Group](/api/components/toggle-group) | Coordinate one or several pressed actions within a roving focus group. |
| [Toolbar](/api/components/toolbar) | Move through a compact set of related actions and invoke the active tool. |
| [Tooltip](/api/components/tooltip) | Reveal concise supporting text from keyboard focus or pointer hover. |
| [Tree Grid](/api/components/tree-grid) | Organize and edit nested resources without losing two-dimensional grid navigation. |
| [Tree View](/api/components/tree-view) | Browse an expandable hierarchy while keeping focus and selection distinct. |
| [Window Splitter](/api/components/window-splitter) | Resize adjacent panes with a quantized, keyboard-accessible separator. |
